name: Ouma no Mori ~Inouja no Gakuen~
original_name: 逢魔の森～異能者の学園～
source:
A boarding school for boys in secluded forest has an unusual committee. 
Main character in invited to participate in this committee by a bad friend and a mysterious transfer student. One day a request comes to investigate a rumor about disappearances in the dormitory. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
偏僻森林中的一所男子寄宿学校设有一个不同寻常的委员会。
主人公受到坏朋友和一名神秘转学生邀请，加入这个委员会。一天，委员会接到委托，要调查宿舍中有人失踪的传闻。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
